subject: True-up orchestration and VAT evidence for Q4 renewal

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: True-up orchestration and VAT evidence for Q4 renewal

Hi Signe —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our agreement in the renewal call, I’m starting the true-up process for the Q4 commitment so we can finalize the revised invoice and get the PO on file. Quick summary of next steps I’m proposing: 

- You share the signed PO (we can accept PDF upload).
- We generate a final pro forma invoice reflecting the usage true-up and any applied credits.
- We confirm VAT treatment (reverse charge vs. local VAT) and you provide your EU VAT certificate if reverse-charge applies.
- We publish a single settlement invoice (no split payments) unless you request staged wires.

Can you confirm: 1) the PO number we should reference, and 2) whether OpenHealth will be supplying a VAT certificate (or prefers Redwood to invoice with VAT)? If you want us to route to your finance team directly, copy their billing contact and we’ll send the DocuSign + invoice.

I’ve CC’d Karthik to help with routing if a special wire flow or escrow is required.

Thanks — aiming to close this week if possible.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Avery,

Thanks — we’ll proceed. PO attached (PO-5461). A few notes from finance: 

- PO number: PO-5461 (attached PDF).
- We are an EU-registered entity; we can provide our VAT certificate. Marek (cc’d) will attach the signed VAT cert and confirm whether reverse charge applies (should be reverse charge, but we’ll confirm).
- Preferred payment: single wire to vendor account, net 30 after invoice date.

If you need a different invoice layout or a separate line for the committed vs. overage amounts for accounting, let us know. We prefer one invoice with a breakdown section.

Regards,
Signe Larsson

signe.larsson@openhealth.com

Subject: FW: PO-5461 / True-up routing — need VAT proof & wire details

Laura / Karthik — forwarding PO from OpenHealth. They want a single invoice with a breakdown (committed vs. overage) and will provide an EU VAT certificate (Marek to attach). Please advise the following so I can reply back with an invoice that matches their AP requirements: 

1) Wire rails and beneficiary name we should include on the invoice (IBAN/BIC).
2) Do we need to issue with VAT or mark as reverse-charge? If reverse-charge, we need their VAT certificate attached to the invoice record.
3) Can we issue net-30? They requested net 30 — does that align with our renewal terms for HS-87432?
4) Any special reference format for Redwood finance to include for their ERP system (they asked for PO-5461 to be present).

I’ve attached a sample invoice template below and the usage breakdown. If finance approves, I’ll create the final invoice and route DocuSign for signature (they prefer PDF + signed PO as backup).

Thanks,
Avery
